title: Studio Interfaces item header at 1010 px: the item title is drawn with no visible text beside the 只读·用覆盖定制 chip and 在「数据」中打开
body:
**Class a · reach: public door.** Studio › 界面 (Interfaces), an `object` view leaf at a 1010 px window: the item header draws the icon, the 视图 kind chip, the 只读·用覆盖定制 chip, 在「数据」中打开 and ⋯, and the item's title has no visible text. At 1280 px the same header reads 任务看板（看板视图）.

## Where it was seen

The seat recorded this while reviewing objectui#12725 phase 4. The dev session `session_01HRnFN6Rtqk2WxPiK6qBhwq` reproduced it live on `main` `26323c4` and on that branch alike, so that PR does not cause it:

- Backend: `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`, published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.3`.
- Display: Chromium, light, zh-CN, 1010 × 900, with the copilot slot open (300 px).
- Leaf: 界面 › 数据模型 › 任务看板（看板视图）. This is `showcase_task`'s `board` kanban view. Its nav entry was added in the browser, because no showcase nav entry lands on a kanban view; the README lists every stub.

Evidence (never-merged evidence branch `claude/issue-12725d-evidence` @ `1f37ce5`):

- `main`, 1010 px: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/1f37ce51ae5ebe171a21af2b7e7285e546b1dfba/docs/design/findings/12725d/before-1010-open.png?raw=true
- `main`, 1280 px (the title shown): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/1f37ce51ae5ebe171a21af2b7e7285e546b1dfba/docs/design/findings/12725d/before-1280-open.png?raw=true
- README with the stubs: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/1f37ce51ae5ebe171a21af2b7e7285e546b1dfba/docs/design/findings/12725d/README.md

## Related, and not a duplicate

- objectui#12791 (closed) made a long api-name chip give way before the title on a Data item, against objectui#12611's 200 px floor.
- objectui#12707 (closed) folds the flow item header's Read-only chip.

Here the title gets no room at all on an Interfaces leaf. The width goes to the header's actions, not to an api-name chip.

## Cause: not measured

A lead, unverified: `StudioItemHeader`'s actions slot is `ml-auto flex shrink-0` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioItemHeader.tsx:291` on `main`). On this leaf it holds the 只读·用覆盖定制 chip and the 在「数据」中打开 button, so nothing in it yields before the title does.

## Done when

- At a 1010 px window with the copilot slot open, an Interfaces view leaf's header shows the title, truncated with its full text in a tooltip if need be, and never empty.
- The actions stay reachable.
- A test pins the title's visible width on that header.
- Live before and after screenshots at 1010 px and 1280 px are on an evidence branch.

Filed by seat `domain:ui#4` (session `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`) as the carrier for an out-of-scope finding of objectui#12725 phase 4. Dedupe words: Studio item header title hidden 1010, StudioItemHeader actions shrink-0, interfaces item header narrow.
